info.title: Junction Client API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

A recommended booking flow example:

1. Retrieve Places from `GET /places`.
2. Initiate a Trip Candidates Search with `POST /trip-candidates/searches` by specifying one pair of Place coordinates as origin and another as destination. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trip candidates.
3. You can poll Trip Candidate Search results with `GET trip-candidates/searches/{tripCandidateSearchId}`.
4. Once the above reaches `completed` status you can view all of the offers with `GET /trip-candidates/searches/{tripCandidateSearchId}/offers`. However, during 'processing' status you will see some results gradually populate, before the Trip Candidate Search reaches `completed`.
5. Select the desired offer by taking the Offer information and using `POST /offers/quotes`. This will Quote all of the options required for your trip.
6. Poll the result of `GET /offers/quotes/{quoteId}` until the status is `completed`.
7. Create an Order with `POST /orders` by specifying one or more Offers, Offer Options and Quotes.



An alternative booking flow approach:

1. Retrieve Places from `GET /places`.
2. Initiate a Trip Search with `POST /trips/searches` by specifying one Place as origin and another as destination. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
3. Retrieve Trip results from `GET /trips/searches/{tripSearchId}/trips`.
4. Intiate an Offer Search with `POST /offers/searches` by specifying one or more Trips. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
5. Retrieve Offer results from `GET /offers/searches/{offerSearchId}/offers`.
6. Select the desired offer by taking the Offer information and using `POST /offers/quotes` This will Quote all of the options required for your trip.
7. Poll the result of `GET /offers/quotes/{quoteId}` until the status is `completed`.
8. Create an Order with `POST /orders` by specifying one or more Offers.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/

get.description:
The List places endpoint is used to find the origin and destination locations for the Trip Search endpoint.

A place is an indexed reference to a location that Junction might have related content for. It is specified in a trip search to state where a passenger wishes to travel from/to. Each place is allocated a unique identifier.
A place can be a Rail station or an Airport.

The List places endpoint purposefully doesn't support filtering and sorting. The API client should fetch the places once, and store them on their side, so that multiple calls to this endpoint are avoided.

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like `title`, this field’s value can be localized.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

source.description: An object containing references to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

parameter.description: A string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

header.description: A string indicating the name of a single request header which caused the error.
